ayahs.1: Beshak (ae Nabi) hum ne aap ko ek khullam-khulla fatah di hai.
ayahs.2: Taake jo kuchh tere gunaah aage hue aur jo peechhe sab ko Allah Taala maaf farmaaye, aur tujh par apna ehsaan poora kar de aur tujhe seedhi raah chalaaye.
ayahs.3: Aur aap ko ek zabardast madad de.
ayahs.4: Wohi hai jis ne musalmanon ke dilon mein sukoon (aur itminan) daal diya taake apne imaan ke saath hi saath aur bhi imaan mein badh jaayen, aur aasmanon aur zameen ke (kul) lashkar Allah hi ke hain. Aur Allah Taala daana ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.5: Taake momin mardon aur auraton ko un jannaton mein le jaaye jin ke neeche nehren beh rahi hain jahan woh hamesha rahenge aur un se un ke gunaah door kar de, aur Allah ke nazdeek yeh bahut badi kaamyabi hai.
ayahs.6: Aur taake un munafiq mardon aur munafiq auraton aur mushrik mardon aur mushrika auraton ko azaab de jo Allah Taala ke baare mein badgumaniyan rakhne wale hain, (darasal) unhi par buraai ka phera hai, Allah un par naraaz hua aur unhein laanat ki aur un ke liye dozakh tayyar ki aur woh (bahut) buri lautne ki jagah hai.
ayahs.7: Aur Allah hi ke liye aasmanon aur zameen ke lashkar hain aur Allah ghaalib aur hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.8: Yaqeenan hum ne tujhe gawaahi dene wala aur khushkhabri sunaane wala aur daraane wala bana kar bheja hai.
ayahs.9: Taake (ae musalmano), tum Allah aur us ke Rasool par imaan laao aur us ki madad karo aur us ka adab karo aur Allah ki paaki bayaan karo subah-o-shaam.
ayahs.10: Jo log tujh se baiat karte hain woh yaqeenan Allah se baiat karte hain, un ke haathon par Allah ka haath hai, to jo shakhs ahd-shikni kare woh apne nafs par hi ahd-shikni karta hai aur jo shakhs is iqraar ko poora kare jo us ne Allah ke saath kiya hai to use anqareeb Allah bahut bada ajr dega.
ayahs.11: Dehatiyon mein se jo log peechhe chhod diye gaye the woh ab tujh se kahenge ke hum apne maal aur baal-bachchon mein lage reh gaye pas aap hamare liye maghfirat talab kijiye. Yeh log apni zabaanon se woh kehte hain jo un ke dilon mein nahin hai. Aap jawab de dijiye ke tumhare liye Allah ki taraf se kisi cheez ka bhi ikhtiyaar kaun rakhta hai agar woh tumhein nuqsaan pahunchaana chaahe to ya tumhein koi nafa dena chaahe to, balke tum jo kuchh kar rahe ho us se Allah khoob ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.12: (Nahin) balke tum ne to yeh gumaan kar rakha tha ke Paighambar aur musalmanon ka apne gharon ki taraf laut aana qatan namumkin hai aur yehi khayal tumhare dilon mein rach-bas gaya tha aur tum ne bura gumaan kar rakha tha. Darasal tum log ho bhi halaak hone wale.
ayahs.13: Aur jo shakhs Allah par aur us ke Rasool par imaan na laaye to hum ne bhi aise kaafiron ke liye dehakti aag tayyar kar rakhi hai.
ayahs.14: Aur zameen aur aasmanon ki baadshahat Allah hi ke liye hai jise chaahe bakhshe aur jise chaahe azaab kare. Aur Allah bada bakhshne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.15: Jab tum ghaneematen lene jaane lagoge to jhat se yeh peechhe chhode hue log kehne lagenge ke hamein bhi apne saath chalne ki ijaazat dijiye, woh chaahte hain ke Allah Taala ke kalaam ko badal den. Aap keh dijiye! Ke Allah Taala pehle hi farma chuka hai ke tum hargiz hamare saath nahin chaloge, woh is ka jawab denge (nahin nahin) balke tum hum se hasad karte ho, (asal baat yeh hai) ke woh log bahut hi kam samajhte hain.
ayahs.16: Aap peechhe chhode hue badwiyon se keh do ke anqareeb tum ek sakht jangjoo qaum ki taraf bulaaye jaaoge ke tum un se ladoge ya woh musalman ho jaayenge pas agar tum itaat karoge to Allah tumhein bahut behtar badla dega aur agar tum ne munh pher liya jaisa ke is se pehle tum munh pher chuke ho to woh tumhein dardnaak azaab dega.
ayahs.17: Andhe par koi harj nahin hai aur na langde par koi harj hai aur na beemar par koi harj hai, jo koi Allah aur us ke Rasool ki farma-bardaari kare use Allah aisi jannaton mein daakhil karega jis ke (darakhton) tale nehren jaari hain aur jo munh pher le use dardnaak azaab (ki saza) dega.
ayahs.18: Yaqeenan Allah Taala mominon se khush ho gaya jabke woh darakht tale tujh se baiat kar rahe the. Un ke dilon mein jo tha ise us ne maloom kar liya aur un par itminan naazil farmaaya aur unhein qareeb ki fatah inaayat farmaayi.
ayahs.19: Aur bahut si ghaneematen jinhein woh haasil karenge aur Allah ghaalib hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.20: Allah Taala ne tum se bahut saari ghaneematon ka waada kiya hai jinhein tum haasil karoge pas yeh to tumhein jaldi hi ata farma di aur logon ke haath tum se rok diye, taake mominon ke liye yeh ek nishaani ho jaaye aur (taake) woh tumhein seedhi raah chalaaye.
ayahs.21: Aur tumhein aur (ghaneematen) bhi de jin par ab tak tum ne qaaboo nahin paaya. Allah Taala ne unhein apne qaaboo mein rakha hai aur Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.22: Aur agar tum se kaafir jang karte to yaqeenan peeth dikha kar bhaagte phir na to koi karsaz paate na madadgaar.
ayahs.23: Allah ke is qaaiday ke mutaabiq jo pehle se chala aaya hai, to kabhi bhi Allah ke qaaiday ko badalta hua na paayega.
ayahs.24: Wohi hai jis ne khaas Makkah mein kaafiron ke haathon ko tum se aur tumhare haathon ko un se rok liya is ke baad ke us ne tumhein un par ghalba de diya tha, aur tum jo kuchh kar rahe ho Allah Taala ise dekh raha hai.
ayahs.25: Yehi woh log hain jinhon ne kufr kiya aur tum ko Masjid-e-Haraam se roka aur qurbani ke liye mauqoof jaanwar ko us ki qurban-gaah mein pahunchne se (roka), aur agar aise (bahut se) musalman mard aur (bahut si) musalman auraten na hotin jin ki tum ko khabar na thi yaani un ke pis jaane ka ehtimaal na hota jis par un ki wajah se tum ko bhi be-khabari mein zarar pahunchta, (to tumhein ladne ki ijaazat de di jaati lekin aisa nahin kiya gaya) taake Allah Taala apni rehmat mein jis ko chaahe daakhil kare aur agar yeh alag alag hote to un mein jo kaafir the hum un ko dardnaak saza dete.
ayahs.26: Jab ke un kaafiron ne apne dilon mein hamiyat ko jagah di aur hamiyat bhi jahiliyat ki, so Allah Taala ne apne Rasool par aur momineen par apni taraf se taskeen naazil farmaayi aur Allah Taala ne musalmanon ko taqwe ki baat par jamaaye rakha aur woh us ke ahl aur zyaada mustahiq the aur Allah Taala har cheez ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.27: Yaqeenan Allah Taala ne apne Rasool ko khwab sachcha dikhaaya ke insha-Allah tum yaqeenan poore aman-o-amaan ke saath Masjid-e-Haraam mein daakhil hoge sar mundwaate hue aur sar ke baal katrawaate hue (chain ke saath) nidar ho kar, woh un umoor ko jaanta hai jinhein tum nahin jaante, pas us ne is se pehle ek nazdeek ki fatah tumhein muyassar ki.
ayahs.28: Wohi hai jis ne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur deen-e-haq ke saath bheja taake ise har deen par ghaalib kare, aur Allah Taala kaafi hai gawaahi dene wala.
ayahs.29: Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) Allah ke Rasool hain aur jo log un ke saath kaafiron par sakht hain aapas mein reham-dil hain, to unhein dekhega ke rukoo aur sajde kar rahe hain Allah Taala ke fazl aur razamandi ki justajoo mein hain, un ka nishaan un ke chehron par sajdon ke asar se hai, un ki yehi misaal Taurat mein hai aur un ki misaal Injeel mein hai, misl isi kheti ke jis ne apna ankhway nikaala phir ise mazboot kiya aur woh mota ho gaya phir apne tane par seedha khada ho gaya aur kisaanon ko khush karne laga taake un ki wajah se kaafiron ko chidhaaye, un imaan walon aur nek aamaal walon se Allah ne bakhshish ka aur bahut bade sawaab ka waada kiya hai.
